finch_ios.title: Sensor Tower — Finch, App Store

habitkit_founder.title: Sebastian Röhl — 2025 annual review
habitkit_founder.facts: Founder reports $602K business revenue and $28K MRR; figures exclude 31 December. FocusKit separately had $874 revenue and $52 MRR. HabitKit downloads: 272K App Store, 290K Play. No store revenue split. January 2025 revenue $112K; monthly revenue stabilized above $40K. These are historical founder reports, not current store-specific estimates.
habitkit_founder.scope: Business / both stores; no store revenue split
